description: Follow-up infrastructure; does not block #568. After the deterministic single-DOCX gate lands, evaluate automated PRs for crawler-ingest revision bumps, dependency hash locking or artifact integrity beyond immutable Git SHAs, per-format/minimal dependency groups to reduce CI cost, and real PDF/XLSX/PPTX converter smoke coverage. Each automated bump must run the mandatory real-converter job and production Docker packaging check. Keep the committed revision and Mix.Tasks.Zaq.Python.Fetch as the sole source-selection/provisioning contract; do not create another downloader or silently track upstream main. Action reuse: extend the same build-time fetch/update contract; no runtime Action or agent-tool exposure.
title: [zaq-lpb] Automate crawler-ingest pin updates and broaden converter CI
